title: THE SECTOR CARDS READ AT A GLANCE
why: Seen on the lift screenshot of 2026-10-07: each sector card on WHERE ARE YOU GOING is as tall as its map, and the name and facts were a 16 pixel and a 13 pixel line across the top of it, so the page looked like two big empty boxes. The name is a heading now and the lines under it are bigger; the words are unchanged.
now: On the lift page the sector names and facts are big enough to read from the couch.
